_about: Which hosts must list each app in the release sandbox: the per-host discovery matrix decided on 14 Oct 2026 (docs/PROTOCOL.md, 'App hosts'). Keys are the app's name in construct.yaml. `hosts` is what the app's labconstrictor-app.yaml must declare; every host listed there must LIST the app and every other host must NOT list it (a `not_listed` assertion, not an absence of a check). `tools_module`: 'required' = the app must ship a *_lc_tools module and lc_tests/cases.json; 'optional' = the app may have none (then nothing is registered, the sandbox says so and checks that nothing is, instead of skipping silently). Read by expected_hosts.py; shared with the Fiji and QuPath drivers (README.md).
